Subject: Amendment in Investment Pattern dated 29th May, 2015(Exempted Trusts)

Ref.: Ministry of Labour & Employment notification bearing no. S.O. 28(E) dated 4th
January, 2021

Sir,
Please refer to above notification on the subject cited above.

2. The notification bearing no. S.O. 28(E) dated 4th January, 2021 has been notified by
MoL&E, regarding amendment in Investment Pattern, published in the Gazette of India,
Extraordinary, Part il, section 3, sub-section(ii), dated 29th May, 2015 for Exempted
Trusts(Copy Attached).

3. In the notification, in the table, in column 2, against category (ii), relating to
investment pattern “Debt Instruments and Related Investments”, after clause (f) and before
the first proviso, the following clause has been inserted, with effect from 11th day of
December, 2019, namely:-

“(g) Units of Debt Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) regulated by the Securities and
Exchange Board of India and managed by an asset management company
appointed as per an agreement with Government of India, specifically meant to invest
in the bonds of the Central Public Sector Enterprises, Central Public Sector
Undertakings, Central Public Financial Institutions and other Government
organisations:”

4. This is for information and necessary action at your end.
(This has the approval of Competent Authority)
(Encl. as above) Yours’ faithfully,

ee,

(Uma Mandal)

MINISTRY OF LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT.

NOTIFICATION
New Delhi, the 4th January, 2021
S.O, 28(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (a) of sub-section (3) of section 17 of the
Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 (19 of 1952), the Central Government hereby
makes the following further amendments in the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Labour and
Employment number S.0.1433 (E), dated the 29" May, 2015, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part
Il, section 3, sub-section(ii), dated the 29" May, 2015, namely:—

in the said notification, in the Table, in column 2, against category (ii), relating to investment pattem “Debt
Instruments and Related Investments”, after clause (f) and before the first proviso, the following clause shall be

inserted, with effect from the 11" day of December, 2019, namely:-

“(g) Units of Debt Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) regulated by the Securitics and Exchange Board of India
and managed by an asset management company appointed as per an agreement with Government of India,
specifically meant to invest in the bonds of the Central Public Sector Enterprises, Central Public Sector

Undertakings, Central Public Financial Institutions and other Government organizations:”.

[F. No. G-20031/1/2012 SS-II (Pt.)]
R.K. GUPTA, J. Secy.

Note :The principal notification was published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part [1, section 3, sub-section
(ii) vide number S.O. 1433(E), dated the 29" May, 2015 and subsequently amended vide S.O. No. 3035(E),
dated 22" September, 2016.
